sourceMethod: imagegen으로 가려진 고정 면을 복원한 production 베이스 + 기존 온전한 움직임 파츠

generation.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ACTUAL production fixed base layer for a layered 2D game water-node animation, not a preview, contact sheet, sprite sheet, or display mockup.
Edit the reference image very narrowly: REMOVE ONLY the SINGLE LARGEST water droplet in the FRONT LEFT of the leaf bowl, including its blue/white rim and cast reflection. Reconstruct the previously occluded green leaf surface completely, with the same hand-painted leaf shading, continuous curved veins, natural olive/sage color, and coherent bowl curvature. This repaired surface will be visible behind the separately animated large water drop. The two smaller water droplets on the RIGHT must remain exactly where they are with the same shapes and apparent sizes.
Preserve all already-visible parts of the original broad leaf: exact outer silhouette, top curl, lower front lip, orientation, perspective, lighting, palette, object size, and composition. Do not cut or simplify the leaf, do not leave any flat-color patch, empty notch, cut contour, dark hole, duplicate edge, smeared texture or striped pixels. Hidden leaf is a real complete painted surface.
Same high-resolution smooth botanical fantasy game illustration with fine dark teal outline and creamy highlights. Whole object centered on the same square canvas. Genuine transparent alpha outside the leaf. No added scenery, labels, shadows, tools, particles, or text.
